concerns.text: Phase 5 (T050-T053) implements 'Computational Universe Exploration' (cellular automata, rule enumeration) which has no corresponding Functional Requirement (FR), Success Criterion (SC), or User Story in spec.md. This is unapproved scope creep; the spec strictly defines the research question around statistical regression on compositional data. These tasks cannot be validated against the spec.

Task T006 is marked [X] (complete) but the Analyze Report flags it as 'REJECTED' due to missing artifacts (logging_schema.yaml). A task cannot be marked complete if its prerequisite artifact generation (T006a) or the task itself is rejected. This creates a false state of completion for a critical infrastructure dependency.

Tasks T020, T021, T021b, and T024 are marked [X] (complete) but the Analyze Report explicitly flags them as 'REJECTED' with missing artifacts (split_dataset function, split_indices.json, rf_model.pkl). These are core tasks for FR-004/FR-005 (Model Training/Validation). Marking them complete while they are rejected prevents the implementation of the core model.

Task T050 references a 'reviewer's comment' regarding 'computational irreducibility' as its primary driver. While the task exists, the tag or description should explicitly link to a specific spec requirement or a formal change request if this scope was added post-spec. Currently, it appears as an orphaned task without a spec anchor (FR/SC/US).
